hebrewText: וַ/יַּ֗עַל גּוֹרַ֛ל מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ גְּב֣וּל גּֽוֹרָלָ֔/ם בֵּ֚ין בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/בֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: properly, a pebble, i.e. a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively, a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot)

a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread)
a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)

tokens.bdb: Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people
to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
